correctness.rationale: The Jacobi-Anger basis gives a diagonal positive operator with lambda_n=int r^3 exp(-r^2/(2z))J_n(r)^2dr. Differentiated Weber integral gives lambda_n=2z^2 e^-z[(n+1-z)I_n+z I_(n+1)]. Bessel completeness gives sum over signed n =2z^2. I_n positive-series bounds show unique constant mode at z<=1/4; n=1 overtakes n=0 at z=1. The rescaled Fourier integral has an L1-dominated kernel converging to (1-y^2/2)e^-y^2/2, uniformly bounding every transform frequency: this proves the all-index Gaussian profile, exact sharp maximum and excluded-frequency spectral gap. Independently computed 45 mode integrals numerically; asymptotic conclusions are analytical, not established by the finite checks.
